call_points.text: Capex will be funded mostly from internal accruals, with debt only as a last-mile top-up if needed.
Treasury was ₹1,650 Cr on 30 June 2026, up from ₹1,520 Cr in March 2026 and ₹1,135 Cr in March 2025.
Treasury income fell because ₹640 Cr was paid to BMC as premium and fees in March 2025 for Tower 2.
Towers 3 and 4 have 100% occupancy, 26 clients, and average rent of about ₹180 per sq ft per month (range ₹150-210).
A few wayside amenity sites were surrendered on local unrest and land issues; ₹1.25-1.5 Cr of project cost hit the June 2026 quarter P&L.
No decision on a bonus issue; the board will decide at an appropriate time in light of expansion plans.
The board recommended a final dividend of ₹7 per share for FY26.
The company will continue virtual AGMs and may arrange more regular investor interaction, possibly every six months.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹251.62 Cr (+31.0% YoY), net profit ₹93.05 Cr (+5.0% YoY).
Nesco applied to NHLML to surrender 4 leased sites on the Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway due to local unrest and site issues.
At its 67th AGM on 27 July 2026, Nesco put Tower 2's investment at about ₹3,500 Cr with a 60-month build from the commencement certificate, and reported FY26 total income of ₹1,031 Cr, up 22%.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹228.44 Cr (-4.5% YoY), net profit ₹105.21 Cr (-11.5% YoY).
Nesco received the BMC Commencement Certificate for Tower 2 and Hall 1 at Nesco Center, valid until October 2027.
